notes.title: FINAL ULTIMATE PRE-RELEASE LIVESTREAM FOR LOVESICK DARLINGS!!!
notes.notes:
Hello Steam users!! Always nice to check in with you guys!!!

As you may have heard, LoveSick Darlings is part of this February's STEAM NEXT FEST!!! Wow! And what better way to celebrate than with a livestream?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36294336/b82aeb548b340ecdf83a2eb692a7f4fd78e00ab1.png[/img]

So... what's going to happen during this "FINAL ULTIMATE PRE-RELEASE LIVESTREAM"?
Honestly? Nothing too crazy! I feel like I've shown pretty much everything I can without giving away all the twists and surprises in this game. So, I'm just gonna do a relatively chill stream where I play the game from where the demo ends with all you guys! So you have an idea of what to expect on the game's launch if you've already finished the demo!

This IS going to be the final livestream before the game comes out, so if you wanna see the full game in action before it comes out, this may be your last chance! It'll also be your last chance to chat to me live! If that's exciting for you for some reason?

And who knows? Maybe I'll sneak one more surprise in... you'll have to come and watch to know for sure!!

I'll be going live on both Steam AND [url=https://www.twitch.tv/lovesickdarlingsofficial]Twitch[/url] at 3pm GMT on February 11th!! Right near the end of the Steam Next Fest (I'm cutting it close because I've been so occupied with writing the end of LoveSick Darlings for that MARCH 27TH RELEASE DATE!)

Here are some handy timezone conversions for other parts of the world! But please do use a timezone converter if you're note sure when I'll be going live!

10am EST February 11th 
7am PST February 11th
2am AEST February 12th

I hope to see you all there! I'll be live for approximately two hours. I love chatting with you guys when I can, and I am well known for yapping on so please come and say hi! Give me a reason to yap!

Thank you all! If I don't see you on the stream, I hope you give the game a try when it LAUNCHES on March 27th!!! Give it a wishlist if you haven't yet!! Boost my algorithm numbers!!!!

notes.title: LoveSIck Darlings DEMO VERSION 1.6 is OUT NOW!!!
notes.notes:
Hey Steam! I'm actually here with an UPDATE for once! Not just a stream announcement! Heck yeah!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36294336/74881916ab53402bec933ea29c336b7fa357b7c2.png[/img]

Actually, I shouldn't hype you up too much. This update is mostly just  'housekeeping' that I've been putting off for... well over a year! Woops! Let's break it down!

Over the last year, while I've been writing like a madman and otherwise working to stay afloat, I've had an accumulation of minor bugs on the 1.5 version of the demo building up on a google doc when they get repoted to me. This google doc, originally dating back to December last year, started off small and with very minor bugs so I kept putting off pushing out the fixes to the live version of the LS Darlings demo.  I thought it might be too much trouble to go the effort of making a new build just for these minor fixes. Then a few medium-sized bugs appeared, and I told myself "Eh, I can do this later. Writing is more important!" Weeks turned to months, and in that time one or two GAME-BREAKING bugs reared their ugly heads and... for some reason I decided I'd wait to fix it still? (I have no idea what I was thinking here.)

This all came to a head when yet another game-breaking bug was reported to me, by a new player who was focusing on spending time with Steph during their first run of the game and ran into a bizarre scenario where they had spent so much time with Steph and were so friendly with her that the game accidentally reset their relationship progress and assumed they hadn't even done the infamous cello trip! Woops!

That was just bad programming on my end, and hearing a new player run into this problem was exactly the wake-up call I needed to go back and polish up the DEMO so that it gives a strong impression to new players!

Admittedly, it did make me sad to see that two of the big game-breaking bugs were associated with spending a lot of time with Steph. They took so long for people to find/report - which sadly shows that she's the least popular heroine... but anyways! That's not relevant!

I finally got my butt into gear and went about stamping out the now long list of bugs, typos, inconsitencies, obscure loops, and glitched prompts! The game should be running smoother than ever! Which is why I'm referring to this as a "housekeeping" update. Considering how this update is mostly about performance and bugs, you may not think it's worth makiing a post or even a new version number for the game - and I don't blame you, I nearly decided to do just that - but after I saw the game had gone over a year since it's last update I figured that was reason enough to justify a new version number. The game hasn't transformed in some new insane way, but in the spirit of "housekeeping" I figured I should dust off the old "1.5" this demo build has had on it for the last year and make it look a bit more shiny and new. This is both good for my morale, and also good for marketing hahah!

I also went back and edited a ton of dialogue from early on in the game to make the earlier incarnations of characters more consistent to their later counterparts and to better set-up certain storylines and character arcs. This is all minor stuff that's important to me, but I doubt will be something players will be able to notice - which is why, despite the shiny new version number, I'm not otherwise treating this update like it's a huge change to the game people need to play ASAP. That is NOT the case, there's no rush to re-download the game! Unless you want to, of course!



[u]Here are the changes:[/u]

[i]- Fixed a glitch where Steph's relationship progress would reset if you spent too much time with her in the demo.

- Fixed another error where Steph references Social Events that haven't taken place yet if you spend too much Free Time with her.

- Fixed the Player Review not detecting obscure combinations of choices and outcomes and skipping to the end accidentally.

- Fixed several visual and animation bugs. Same with music loops and cues.

- Sharpened dialogue in the beginning section to flow better and more accurately represent characters (Syd used to say "like" a lot! That's so not in-character for him. I fixed a lot of those kinds of inconsistent mannerisms for the cast.)

- Inserted about two dozen extra invisible variables the demo can trigger that won't pay off until you play the full game.

- Fixed countless typos and awkward sentences.[/i]



When I have time, before launch, I actually plan to use this build to do tiny "soft" patches to fix minor things like the animation style of the game - because it has changed a lot since launch! In the early days, I had character occupy default parameters ont he screen, but as development continued I started setting custom parameters for characters to occupy. This is especially the case during the first "week" of the game. This is something I can fix any time, but it will be time-consuming to manually change all of the first week's animation. I'd rather spend that time writing, so for now that change is going to the backlog. But it's something you can expect before the game launches (eventually!)

If you feel the need to check the update out for yourself, feel free to download the new build from itch right now! But like I said, the changes in 1.6 are mostly invisible. I wouldn't go out of your way unless you feel like seeing the gang at Foster Hills High again!

The update is also live on Steam, so if that's your preferred platform - the game will automatically update there!

Anyways, that's everything abut the update! I hope you've all had a great 2022. I'm sorry that once again another year has gone by without LoveSick Darlings being completed.... but it's getting there! Bit by bit! I promise! I'm still passionate about this game and can't wait for you all to finally play it when it's ready!

Have a happy holiday season!

- Dimitri

notes.title: LoveSick Darlings 1.5.1 DEMO Patch Notes!
notes.notes:
LoveSick Darlings 1.5.1 is out now!

Some quick notes... 

- Fixed some inconcistencies in Albie's backstory.
- Fixed a King Crimson Moment that would occur on Week 7 Wednesday if you tried to hang out with Steph! (the game would skip the entire hang-out! Woops!)
- Many typos.
- Background changes, like the rate of which Steph would gauge your relationships with Maisy and Jayda (its a bit more generous now!)

Check it out now! It should be in your downloads! Let me know if you have any issues!

Thanks everyone!

notes.title: LOVESICK DARLINGS 1.4 DEMO UPDATE IS OUT NOW!!!
notes.notes:
[h1]LoveSick Darlings 1.4 Demo is out now! [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36294336/b2a62de7372e5c7d79ecf414f092fb3040456518.png[/img]

What's new, you may be asking? Well, I'm glad you asked! Let's get into it!

[h2]New Demo Features:[/h2]

- COMPLETELY OVERHAULED MUSIC. I am no longer using free music from Visual Novel Resource websites! [url=https://mobile.twitter.com/FulminisIctus]Tim Reichert[/url] has completed a FULL 20+ OST specifically for LoveSick Darlings under my direction to match the characters and story! I really think you'll love it!

- BRAND NEW UI. GUI artist [url=https://mobile.twitter.com/M_is_scared]"m."[/url] has done a complete overhaul of the game's UI. THis features a Date/Time display, new text boxes, special effects, menus, and MORE!

- Partial voice acting performed by an ALL-AUSTRALIAN cast has been fully implemtned into the game! Scenes you know and love have found new life with their voices!

- Bug fixes! (Heck yeah!!)

- And more little surprises, secrets, and art assets! I hope you enjoy!

[h3]What are you waiting for? DOWNLOAD IT NOW![/h3]

If you or anyone else you know who would enjoy LoveSick Darlings haven't tried it out yet... why not try it now?

Many people out there have more free time than ever,  and there is NO BETTER time to try out LoveSick Darlings! The new art, music, voice acting, UI, and more gives the best player experience yet! Or maybe even send it to your favourite streamer or let's player? Do what you will! I really want this updated demo to reach as many people as it can!

ALSO: please send me ANY and ALL feedback you have for this updated version of the game when you get the chance. I value all of your opinions and wanna hear as much as I can from you all! Reach out to me on Twitter, Discord, or even via Steam!

Wanna find out more about the specifics of this new version of the demo and how it came to be? Check out the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lovesickdarlings/lovesick-darlings-a-visual-novel-with-consequences/posts/2933845]August development update on Kickstarter![/url]
